title: Payment logic to duplicate value
summary: Connect trusted-price validation, payment binding, idempotency, and bounded concurrency into a zero-value transaction integrity assessment.
safety: Use only sandbox or zero-value transactions, disposable objects, and a few synchronized requests. Never charge cards, consume inventory, or trigger fulfillment.

nodes.label: Bind provider event to order, amount, and currency

edges.condition: A sandbox checkout and authoritative order record are available.
Transaction binding is understood and one safe replay is approved.
Sequential idempotency controls are established and bounded concurrency is explicitly approved.
